children: A power outage on Sunday was reported at ExxonMobil's 275,000 b/d Joliet refinery in Channahon, Ill., according to a company spokesperson.

"The refinery experienced a power outage on September 13 at around 3:30 p.m. resulting in a shutdown. Power was restored at around 7:00 p.m.," the statement said. "We are currently progressing through site status assessment. We're still working to determine the cause of the power outage and are in touch with the appropriate agencies. The safety of the community and our workforce remains our primary focus."
